cues: A half kilogram body on a spring of force constant two hundred newtons per metre oscillates with amplitude ten centimetres.
Find the period, the total energy, and the kinetic and potential energies at five centimetres.
text: A worked example. A half kilogram body on a spring of force constant two hundred newtons per metre oscillates with amplitude ten centimetres. Find the period, the total energy, and the kinetic and potential energies at five centimetres.
